The dynamic capability self-model can reduce random Tool probing, but mature-designer planning efficiency and correct capability choice are not established until varied real tasks measure first-effective-write latency, invalid attempts and human design review.

Repeated control declarations and observations may consume the budget needed for mutation, readback and evaluation until TaskRun owns liveness.
Automated checks, one canary, Tool success or model self-review must not be promoted to design-quality or delivery completion.
Unverified experience must not enter production Memory, Knowledge, Recipe or Skill.
R-040 is contained on the current chain, but M5 must still establish the single Release Gate and remove all bypass consumers.

liveSkuValidationSlice.summary: Use the user's currently running DesignEcho and real project to measure and fix first-write latency, redundant project-image vision calls, authoritative SKU fact acquisition, Photoshop execution/readback and reviewed 2/3/4-pair output quality without adding a sample-specific route.

browserExtVisualRefSlice.summary: Extend the DesignEcho browser assistant so the Agent can actually see reference-page images: readPage includeImages downloads page images in the logged-in browser context into the model vision channel, and capture fullPage stitches multi-slice long screenshots with scroll restore.

toolUnderstandingUsageAuditSlice.summary: Audit all 164 Agent tools across understanding and usage with 15 parallel agents, then fix the high-risk gaps: an unimplemented-dispatch tool now registered, verify-readback hints wired into every write/export tool description, per-tool boundary and do-not-use entries for ~30 high-frequency/destructive tools, and parameter descriptions for the high-frequency subset.

runtimeDeclarationRecoverySlice.summary: Remove dead duplicate Harness ownership, derive a single publishable Runtime Profile catalog from real Manifests, repair declaration shape once, and prevent an invalid control turn from consuming the production budget before the first write.

autonomousDesignKernelSlice.summary: Converge generation-scoped project and reviewed-memory context, complete same-history visual ReviewSets, bounded quality repair and request-scaled cost governance; exact text edits use a signed unique-target CAS lane while full creative work retains richer design and review budgets.

observationLivenessSlice.summary: Stop repeated document and image observation from masquerading as progress by binding reuse and liveness to trusted target revisions, real TaskRun state and bounded novel evidence; retire text and file-extension guessed action recovery and close the existing reobserve-to-replan transition.

governanceSlice.summary: Converge the existing Task, Context, Runtime, Capability, Evidence, Aesthetic, Completion and Compound Budget Harness layers without creating another Runtime or authority owner.

controlledInsertSlice.summary: Integrate deterministic studio-source shape normalization and editable neutral-gray lighting correction into the single SKU Skill, with a manual UXP dual-mode entry for INS layout-only and studio retouch color cards.

skuProblemDiscoverySlice.summary: Reconcile authoritative SKU execution facts with revision-bound artifact metadata, document structure and visible text; perform only bounded single-text remediation, and remove repeated workflow activation, document-layer polling and template inventory scans.

multimodalComposerSlice.summary: Persist and edit text, uploaded images, Eagle assets, project assets and governed knowledge as one ordered message; project the same frozen submission into visible history, Operating Context and the default Agent without exposing model-only reference markers or bypassing visual budgets.

harnessRecoveryAndDiagnosticsSlice.summary: Discover real project Run Records, keep Skill-internal atomic Photoshop calls under the Harness target/revision owner, reconcile unknown writes without replay, apply bounded truncation recovery, require strict UXP write readback and keep machine diagnostics private from designer-facing communication.
